bio: Josephine R. Heffernan (30 Dec 1883 - 8 Mar 1984) graduated as a nurse from St. Joseph's Hospital, Reading, in 1906 (Wilkes-Barre Record, 31 Mar 1906), married George J. Wagner, moved to California, and died at Alameda aged 100.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
